notes: ANZSCO occupations sourced from the ABS ANZSCO 2022 Australian Update (Table 5: Major, Sub-Major, Minor, Unit Groups and Occupations).
Skilled list assignments (MLTSSL, STSOL, ROL, CSOL) sourced live from the Department of Home Affairs Skilled Occupation List page.
MLTSSL, STSOL and ROL use ANZSCO 2013 codes; CSOL uses ANZSCO 2022 codes. Where a code appears in both versions with the same numeric value, lists are merged.
CSOL = Core Skills Occupation List (used by subclass 482 Core Skills stream and subclass 186 Direct Entry from late 2024).
Occupations marked with note "ANZSCO 2013 code; not present in ANZSCO 2022 structure" appear on legacy lists only.
